# Flood Fixers

> 24/7 restoration services in San Diego, CA.

Flood Fixers (Flood Fixers) is a professional restoration contractor serving San Diego, CA and surrounding areas. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (855) 204-1124.
